name: Documentation Engineering & Canonical Markdown Publishing
purpose: Maintain canonical Markdown documentation for users, developers, and operators with explicit ownership, authority roles, drift detection against code, link integrity, and versioned publishing.
inputs: Documentation scope: audience, pages in scope, and authority roles
Source of truth links: code modules, schemas, or configs each page documents
Publishing setup: docs site toolchain, link checker, target version branch
Ownership map: named owner per page plus review cadence
outputs: Updated pages with frontmatter, runnable examples, and verified links
Drift report with findings owned and dated, or an explicit clean bill
Publishing record with built site version and review schedule
stop_conditions: All touched pages accurate against current code with zero broken links and clean site build
Drift findings fixed or tracked as defects with owners and fix-by dates
Owners and next review dates recorded for every touched page
